name: annotate-cli
description: Annotate skill toolbox: one skill per annotation tool, read by the annotate doer as reference material, plus the offline backend check the doer runs before annotating. Neurobagel (bagel-cli) validates and converts, reproschema validates instrument schemas, pynidm converts and can resolve terms interactively, and snomed-lookup queries whichever licensed SNOMED source the user configured. The never-recall-a-term rule stays with the doer.
